blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Metamorphic rocks are created by modifying pre-existing rocks via intense heat, pressure, or chemical action.
They are characterized by being extremely hard and compact in texture.
The original structure of the rock changes completely during formation.
Recrystallization occurs during the transformation process.
Exams frequently test the agents of metamorphic rock formation: intense heat, high pressure, and chemical processes.
Key diagnostic feature: Metamorphic rocks undergo recrystallization and possess an extremely hard, compact nature.
